assets.prompt: Create a 16:9 background for a 2D side-scrolling game. Side elevation, no perspective floor, no character, UI, lettering or realistic brick texture. Clear readable silhouettes, restrained gradients, cohesive muted palette.

Transparent game terrain asset atlas in a 2 by 2 layout: purple cavern rock fill, purple rock platform with bright lime moss/slime top edge, magenta metal walkway, magenta horizontal industrial pipe. Flat cartoon side elevation matching reference images. Separate assets with generous transparent gutters. Horizontal walkable tops, clean silhouettes, no perspective, no text, characters or background. Preserve real alpha.

Transparent 3 by 2 prop atlas for the supplied flat cartoon cavern game. Top row: cyan crystal cluster on purple rock, magenta mushroom with lime slime, magenta pipe elbow. Strict side elevation, isolated objects, generous gutters, consistent purple/cyan/lime palette, no labels or UI. Preserve real transparent alpha.

Create a 16:9 title-screen background matching the supplied 2D flat cartoon purple cavern and laboratory references. Magenta pipes, cyan crystals, a lime-green pool, quiet dark lavender cave shapes, a cute DNA laboratory tank at the left edge, crystals and a valve on the right. Keep broad left/central negative space for editable title and buttons and space on the right for the drain spirit.
